description: The steps of one process and where it stands: an ordered list whose markers say which steps are complete, which one is current and which are still ahead. Every state is drawn and spoken. With `interactive`, the steps behind the current one are buttons that report their index.

ariaLabel.description: Names the list: which process this is the progress of, such as Checkout, never Steps. Required, and guarded at runtime after trimming: two steppers on one page are indistinguishable otherwise.

steps.description: The process, in order. Arena draws each step from its fields; an empty list draws nothing.

index.description: Which step is current, counted from zero. The steps before it are complete and the ones after it upcoming. A value at or past the number of steps marks every step complete, and a negative or non-finite one reads as 0.

interactive.description: Whether the steps behind the current one can be chosen. Only those steps become buttons: the current step and every step ahead stay text, so a reader never meets a dead control.

valueChange.description: A step behind the current one was chosen; carries its index, counted from zero. Never fires while `interactive` is false, nor for the current step or a later one. The host owns `index` and moves it.
